Vulnerability in Cosminexus Component Container
Overview
Cosminexus Service Coordinator, which uses the SOAP communication infrastructure of Cosminexus Component Container, contains an XXE (XML External Entity) vulnerability in user-defined reception services (SOAP reception services) or SOAP adapters operating in SOAP 1.1 mode.
